question: Can one uv command provision a fresh working-tree-derived repository and complete the five-metric hosted-video benchmark?
scope: SDR smoke workload, five established metrics; concurrent PSNR-HVS compiled but excluded; no baseline/speedup or CPU/GPU reference speed comparison
prerequisite_limit: Fresh repository directories, not a clean operating-system installation; preinstalled system tools/driver and global uv interpreter/package caches may be reused.

timing_contract.selected_iteration: Per clip, select the timed iteration with median core duration and retain its core/decode values.
timing_contract.reported_core_clip_statistic: Per round, median of 39 selected complete-clip core durations; aggregate distribution across five rounds.
timing_contract.candidate_wall: All CLI iterations, warmups, decoding and setup.
timing_contract.workflow_wall: Outer workflow including preparation, hashing and agreement evaluation.
timing_contract.reference_durations: Not used as CPU/GPU compute-speed denominators.

device_probe.selection: same default Vulkan selector as normal CLI; probe only, no clip scoring
